headline: Sensex drops 319 points and Nifty slips below 25,150 amid profit booking and inflation concerns

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian benchmark indices snapped a three-day winning streak due to profit booking.
Rising crude oil prices revived inflation concerns among investors.
Weak cues from Gift Nifty set a negative tone for the trading session.
Mixed Q2 corporate earnings reports induced stock-specific movement.
whatHappening: Sensex declined by 319 points while Nifty 50 dropped to close below 25,150.
Shriram Finance and Manappuram Finance featured among the prominent loss-makers.
Eicher Motors reported a 15% increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,573 crore but missed market estimates.
Godrej Industries reported a surge in Q2 profit to Rs 560 crore.
summary: Indian equity markets ended lower as the Sensex dropped 319 points and Nifty closed below 25,150. Rising crude oil prices and elevated inflation data prompted investors to book profits after a three-day rally. Individual stock action was driven by Q2 earnings results and executive appointments.
